digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolver
propositions: Rebar must support per-capability-tier model configuration (frontier, standard, trivial) parsed from layered config (CLI > env > file > default) with model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array per slot.

Each class slot resolves to a provider-qualified model string; omitted provider is inferred via existing infer_provider logic; unset slots use documented class defaults preserving current behavior when nothing is configured.
Secrets must remain env-only: slots and fallback entries reject api_key with a typed config error, enforcing the existing secrets boundary.
Fallback entries form a non-recursive ordered chain, each carrying model (required), provider (optional, inferred), endpoint (optional), rejecting api_key and nested fallback keys with typed errors.

load_class_slots(repo_root) entry point in model_classes.py reads [tool.rebar.llm].model_classes from merged config via _read_llm_file_table, making the schema reachable from real configuration and gracefully degrading to defaults when the sub-table is absent.
Environment layer flattens nested slots into per-field env vars (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL etc.) maintaining existing precedence rules per key rather than inventing object merge semantics.
